About.intro: A legal strategist based in Yerevan, dedicated to representing founders, executives, and enterprises in their most consequential disputes. Where others see complexity, I find leverage.
bio: Vache Simonyan is the founder of Versus Law Firm, a boutique practice built on a single conviction: in high-stakes legal conflict, the outcome is decided before the first move is made. Over more than a decade of practice, he has represented clients across criminal defense, commercial litigation, and cross-border arbitration.

His approach blends rigorous preparation with relentless execution. He has intervened at the earliest stages of investigations to protect clients' rights, dismantled prosecutorial arguments to secure release, and led arbitration defenses against international claimants — consistently turning pressure into advantage.

Beyond the courtroom, Vache advises businesses navigating Armenia's evolving regulatory landscape, from fintech licensing to corporate restructuring. He is known for his directness, his command of detail, and his refusal to accept uncertainty as an outcome.

doing-business-in-armenia.title: Gateway to Armenia: A Strategic Briefing
doing-business-in-armenia.intro: Armenia offers a unique intersection of high-skilled human capital and significant tax incentives. However, navigating the regulatory nuances requires a focus on structural integrity.

sections.title: Regulatory Nuances
sections.content: Unlike many CIS jurisdictions, Armenia has robust protections for foreign investors, including the right to own 100% of local subsidiaries and no restrictions on profit repatriation.

sections.title: Tax Incentives & IT Free Zones
sections.content: The IT sector enjoys a 0% corporate tax rate (until 2025/2026) and significantly reduced income tax (10%). Leveraging these zones requires precise corporate structuring from day one.

sections.title: Common Pitfalls
sections.content: The most common failure for international firms is assuming 'standard' templates will work. Local employment laws and real estate title chains require specific Armenian expertise.

criminal-defense.title: Criminal Defense and Representation
rows: The Firm provides comprehensive legal representation in criminal matters at all stages of criminal proceedings, including the pre-trial investigation and trial. We protect the rights and legitimate interests of accused persons, witnesses, victims, as well as legal entities involved in criminal proceedings.

Our services include the development of defense strategies in complex criminal cases, representation before investigative authorities, prosecutors, and courts of all instances, as well as the design and implementation of effective legal strategies aimed at safeguarding our clients’ rights, freedoms, and legitimate interests.

We also represent victims of criminal offenses, including companies, business owners, and organizations that have suffered harm as a result of unlawful actions or omissions by criminal justice authorities during criminal proceedings.

extradition-international-criminal-law.title: Extradition representation and Human rights protection
rows: We advise and represent individuals who are the subject of extradition requests, challenge extradition decisions, and protect clients against unlawful surrender to foreign jurisdictions.

Protecting the rights of individuals facing extradition often requires comprehensive legal representation extending beyond criminal and international law to include strategic use of migration and asylum law mechanisms.

Our work includes conducting independent factual investigations, identifying, collecting, preserving, and securing evidence, interviewing witnesses, analyzing the actions of state authorities and judicial proceedings, and developing comprehensive legal and evidentiary records demonstrating violations of fundamental human rights.

A properly prepared evidentiary record establishing procedural and other fundamental human rights violations in the requesting state is often the decisive factor in securing the refusal of an extradition request. In such cases, the outcome of extradition proceedings frequently depends on the quality of the evidence gathered and the strength of the legal strategy developed in support of the client’s case.

interpol-matters.title: INTERPOL Matters
rows: Comprehensive legal assistance in matters involving INTERPOL Red Notices, Diffusions, and other international alerts. We represent individuals before the Commission for the Control of INTERPOL’s Files (CCF) and provide strategic advice to clients facing international law enforcement measures.

Our services include legal assessment of INTERPOL-related risks, analysis of criminal proceedings underlying INTERPOL requests, collection and preservation of evidence, preparation of factual and legal submissions, and the development of comprehensive strategies aimed at preventing, challenging, correcting, or deleting INTERPOL data.

A critical part of our INTERPOL practice is the preparatory work conducted before any application is submitted to the Commission for the Control of INTERPOL’s Files (CCF). Prior to filing, we carry out a comprehensive legal and factual assessment of the case, identify potential weaknesses, collect and verify supporting evidence, obtain relevant court and administrative documents, and develop a tailored legal strategy designed to maximize the prospects of success.

Our objective is to ensure that every application is supported by a complete and well-documented evidentiary record, thereby significantly reducing the risk of rejection and increasing the likelihood of obtaining access, correction, or deletion of INTERPOL data.

international-human-rights.title: International Human Rights Protection
rows: We represent individuals whose fundamental rights have been violated by state authorities, providing legal representation before national courts, international human rights bodies, and regional mechanisms, including the United Nations treaty bodies and the European Court of Human Rights.

Our practice covers a broad range of matters, including arbitrary and unlawful detention, torture and ill-treatment, violations of fair trial guarantees, freedom of expression and privacy rights, asylum and refugee status applications, and the application of the non-refoulement principle to prevent the return of individuals to states where they face persecution or serious harm.

We advise and represent clients facing politically motivated prosecution, providing strategic guidance on protective measures, including urgent applications for interim measures before international bodies to prevent deportation, extradition, or other irreversible harm while a case is pending.

Our work includes preparing individual complaints and communications to international human rights mechanisms, gathering and presenting evidence of rights violations, and pursuing remedies aimed at securing recognition of violations, protective measures, and just compensation for our clients.

betting-gaming-law.title: Betting and Gaming Law
rows: Legal support for betting operators, online casino operators, and other companies providing services to the online gaming industry, with a particular focus on preventing criminal law risks.

We advise companies on the lawful structuring of their operations, the identification and mitigation of criminal liability risks, the development of compliance strategies, and the protection of owners, executives, and key personnel against potential criminal prosecution.

Our services include the ongoing management of legal risks to ensure the safe, lawful, and sustainable operation of betting, gaming, and other businesses associated with the gaming industry across multiple jurisdictions.
